Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas Day shall be paid one and one-half times
their regular hourly rate.

No additional economic benefits will accrue to PRN Nurses under the terms of this
Agreement or the Personnel Rules of the Commonwealth.

If you have any questions regarding this matter, please contact Carol Scott at 717
787 6549.

Sincerely,
Nancy Denning Martin
Deputy Secretary for Human Resources and Management

cc: Secretary Barnett
Donald O. Adams
Carol S. Scott
Ralph Winters
HR Directors in agencies with 1199p represented employees
Labor Coordinators in agencies with 1199p represented employees
